articles.title_en: How responsive are nutrients in India? Some recent evidence
articles.title_cn: 印度的营养摄入对收入变化的响应程度如何？一些近期证据
articles.abstract_en: The relationship between nutrient intake and income is an issue of huge policy relevance, especially in the developing world. Using large-scale household-level data from India, this paper analyzes how macronutrient and micronutrient intakes respond to changes in income in both rural and urban areas. It also investigates how food consumption patterns change over time. In a first, this paper employs different estimation approaches i.e., parametric, semi-parametric and non-parametric estimation models to obtain more recent and robust nutrient-income elasticity estimates for three macronutrients and four essential micronutrients. The parametric (OLS) calorie-expenditure elasticities were lower than those estimated for protein and fat. Micronutrients also yielded positive and statistically significant elasticities. In terms of the parametric (IV) estimation, elasticities also declined over time and had lower magnitudes than the parametric (OLS) estimates. Relative to protein, fat and micronutrient intakes, caloric intakes are less sensitive to changes in income. According to parametric (OLS and IV) estimation, calcium is the most income-responsive micronutrient, while zinc is the least. The preferred semi-parametric estimation strategy provides full flexibility to income effects while also simultaneously controlling for additional covariates parametrically, assisting in determining the true relationship between nutrient intake and income. Consistent with the parametric estimation, elasticities were positive and statistically significant. The augmented semi-parametric elasticities, which address endogeneity concerns, were lower than the non-augmented ones. The semi-parametric elasticity curves depict that the relationship between demand for nutrients and income is indeed non-linear and non-monotonic. The findings from this research demonstrate that it is critical to evaluate the effect of income across the entire income distribution, and not just at the means. Even when the elasticities are low, they are always more pronounced for the poor, who are the most vulnerable to malnutrition. The study conducts a battery of checks that further lend credence to the robustness of the main findings. Given the current landscape of India’s nutrition economy, the findings of this study would serve to be useful for designing apt future nutritional interventions and public health policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 营养摄入与收入之间的关系是一个具有巨大政策相关性的问题，尤其是在发展中国家。利用来自印度的大规模住户层面数据，本文分析了农村和城市地区宏量营养素和微量营养素的摄入如何响应收入变化，并研究了食物消费模式随时间的变化。本文首次采用了不同的估计方法，即参数、半参数和非参数估计模型，以获得三种宏量营养素和四种必需微量营养素更近期且稳健的营养-收入弹性估计。参数（OLS）卡路里-支出弹性低于蛋白质和脂肪的估计值。微量营养素也产生了正且统计显著的弹性。就参数（IV）估计而言，弹性随时间下降，且幅度低于参数（OLS）估计。相对于蛋白质、脂肪和微量营养素的摄入，卡路里摄入对收入变化的敏感度较低。根据参数（OLS和IV）估计，钙是对收入最敏感的微量营养素，而锌是最不敏感的。优选的半参数估计策略为收入效应提供了完全灵活性，同时以参数方式控制额外的协变量，有助于确定营养摄入与收入之间的真实关系。与参数估计一致，弹性为正且统计显著。增强的半参数弹性解决了内生性问题，其值低于非增强的弹性。半参数弹性曲线表明，营养需求与收入之间的关系确实是非线性和非单调的。本研究的发现表明，评估收入对整个收入分布的影响至关重要，而不仅仅是均值处。即使弹性较低，它们对最易受营养不良影响的贫困人群而言总是更为显著。本研究进行了一系列检验，进一步支持了主要发现的稳健性。鉴于印度营养经济的当前状况，本研究的发现将有助于设计适当的未来营养干预措施和公共卫生政策。

articles.title_en: True to type? EU-style date marking and the valuation of perishable food
articles.title_cn: 名副其实？欧盟式日期标注与易腐食品的估值
articles.abstract_en: Date marking is intended to help consumers make informed food safety and quality choices when confronted with perishable food products. We provide causal in-store evidence on how EU-style date marking (best before and use by) influences consumers’ valuation of perishable food around the expiry date. In a preparatory survey (n=100), we first identify perishable food items amenable to experimental manipulation. A modified multiple price list (MPL) experiment (n=200) then tests shoppers’ valuation of perishable food with expiry dates in the future and the past. We vary date mark type (use-by versus best-before) and information status (with and without education) while preventing free disposal censoring. We find that expiry dates affect consumer valuation. Variation in date mark type has little practical relevance. Educating consumers about the meaning of date mark types reduces willingness to pay for potentially unsafe food, but does not increase it for more durable items. An attentiveness experiment (n=160) finds that inattention and consumers’ native understanding of current date marks can explain the evidence from the modified MPL experiment. Jointly, these results help explaining existing observational evidence and assessing the prospects of consumer education campaigns.
articles.abstract_cn: 日期标注旨在帮助消费者在面对易腐食品时做出明智的食品安全和质量选择。我们提供了关于欧盟式日期标注（最佳食用日期和保质期）如何影响消费者在到期日前后对易腐食品估值的因果性店内证据。在一项预备调查（n=100）中，我们首先确定了适合实验操作的易腐食品项目。随后，一项修改后的多重价格表（MPL）实验（n=200）测试了购物者对具有未来和过去到期日的易腐食品的估值。我们变化日期标注类型（保质期与最佳食用日期）和信息状态（有教育与无教育），同时防止自由处置审查。我们发现到期日影响消费者估值。日期标注类型的变化几乎没有实际相关性。教育消费者了解日期标注类型的含义降低了他们对潜在不安全食品的支付意愿，但并未增加对更耐储存物品的支付意愿。一项注意力实验（n=160）发现，注意力不集中和消费者对当前日期标注的本能理解可以解释修改后的MPL实验中的证据。综合来看，这些结果有助于解释现有的观察性证据，并评估消费者教育运动的前景。

articles.title_en: Earn a living? What the Côte d’Ivoire–Ghana cocoa living income differential might deliver on its promise
articles.title_cn: 谋生？科特迪瓦-加纳可可生活收入差价可能兑现其承诺
articles.abstract_en: Despite the high value of the global chocolate market and the high profitability of the few multinational companies dominating it, the farmers growing cocoa beans remain poor. To change this, the two biggest cocoa producers, Côte d’Ivoire and Ghana, have jointly introduced the cocoa Living Income Differential (LID) policy. Charging higher prices for beans, the policy might help mitigate both poverty and the serious child labour and deforestation issues associated with cocoa farming, for which poverty is regarded as a root cause. Nevertheless, the design of the policy and the current lack of complementary measures raise doubts about the success and longevity of the policy and concerns about the implications for farmers in other countries. Accounting for the repercussions with international cocoa markets, this study quantifies the magnitude of the policy’s effects in the LID countries and elsewhere under several alternative configurations of policies and market reactions with the support of model simulations and finds increases in farmer income ranging from zero to sizeable. Discussing the policy’s potential impacts in the past and present context of the cocoa industry, it identifies a number of issues threatening its sustainability. Moreover, it underlines the strong dependence of the policy’s success on chocolate manufacturers’ support unless complemented by supply management measures. Such measures could limit the aggravation of, or even improve, the income situation for farmers elsewhere and the child labour and deforestation issues.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管全球巧克力市场价值高昂，且主导该市场的少数跨国公司盈利能力很强，但种植可可豆的农民仍然贫困。为了改变这一状况，两大可可生产国科特迪瓦和加纳联合推出了可可生活收入差价（LID）政策。该政策对可可豆收取更高的价格，可能有助于缓解贫困以及与可可种植相关的严重童工和森林砍伐问题，而贫困被视为这些问题的根源。然而，该政策的设计以及目前缺乏配套措施，使人们对政策的成功和持久性产生怀疑，并担忧其对其他国家农民的影响。考虑到国际可可市场的连锁反应，本研究通过模型模拟，在几种不同的政策组合和市场反应情景下，量化了该政策在LID国家及其他地区的影响程度，发现农民收入的增加从零到可观不等。结合可可行业过去和现在的背景讨论该政策的潜在影响，本研究指出了若干威胁其可持续性的问题。此外，研究强调，除非辅以供应管理措施，否则该政策的成功在很大程度上取决于巧克力制造商的支持。此类措施可以限制甚至改善其他国家农民的收入状况以及童工和森林砍伐问题。

articles.title_en: Indigenous bone fertilizer for growth and food security: A local solution to a global challenge
articles.title_cn: 本土骨肥促进增长与粮食安全：应对全球挑战的地方解决方案
articles.abstract_en: We examine the process of recycling the phosphorus that naturally occurs in animal bones, compare the cost of recycled phosphorus to that of conventional phosphorus fertilizer, and measure farmers’ willingness to pay for recycled phosphorus. In our research setting of rural Ethiopia, we reach three conclusions. First, we demonstrate that it is possible to make a suitable pelletized P fertilizer from animal bones. Second, we estimate that the recycled P fertilizer costs 16% to 39% less than importing conventional fertilizer. Third, we find that farmer’s willingness to pay for recycled phosphorus fertilizer is the same as that for conventional fertilizer.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了动物骨骼中天然存在的磷的回收过程，比较了回收磷与传统磷肥的成本，并衡量了农民对回收磷的支付意愿。在我们的研究背景——埃塞俄比亚农村中，我们得出三个结论。首先，我们证明利用动物骨骼可以制造出合适的颗粒状磷肥。其次，我们估计回收磷肥的成本比进口传统肥料低16%至39%。第三，我们发现农民对回收磷肥的支付意愿与传统肥料相同。

articles.title_en: Recall information heterogeneity and perceived health risk: The impact of food recall on fresh meat market in the U.S
articles.title_cn: 召回信息异质性与感知健康风险：美国鲜肉市场食品召回的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the heterogeneous impact of various recall information on consumers’ perceived health risks and quantifies the overall impact of food recalls on demand. Using the fresh meat market as a case study, this paper formulates a structural random coefficient discrete choice model of consumer demand. Among various characteristics of food recalls, our focuses are the number of recalls and the volume of food recalled. In addition to the latest recall information, the historical recall information may also change consumers’ perception of health risks and we include the interaction terms of the historical recall information and the latest recall information into the model. Results show that both the number of recalls and the volume of food recalled have negative and significant effects on the demand. Historical recalls are also important to mitigate the negative impact of the latest recalls on the market. To minimize the negative impact of recalls, the highest priority should be given to preventing large-scale recalls, Class I recalls, product contamination recalls, and recalls due to being produced without benefit of inspection or import violation. Food companies should take the initiative to recall when problems arise. Further, simulation results imply that the number of recalls plays a much larger role than the volume of food recalled in meat demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了不同召回信息对消费者感知健康风险的异质性影响，并量化了食品召回对需求的总体影响。以鲜肉市场为案例，本文构建了一个结构化的随机系数离散选择模型来刻画消费者需求。在食品召回的各种特征中，我们重点关注召回次数和被召回食品的数量。除了最新的召回信息外，历史召回信息也可能改变消费者对健康风险的认知，我们将历史召回信息与最新召回信息的交互项纳入模型。结果表明，召回次数和被召回食品的数量对需求均有显著的负向影响。历史召回对于缓解最新召回对市场的负面影响也很重要。为最小化召回的负面影响，应优先防止大规模召回、I级召回、产品污染召回以及因未经检验或违反进口规定而生产的召回。食品企业在出现问题时应主动召回。此外，模拟结果表明，在肉类需求中，召回次数所起的作用远大于被召回食品的数量。

articles.title_en: Evaluating cereal market (dis)integration in less developed and fragile markets: The case of Sudan
articles.title_cn: 评估欠发达和脆弱市场中的谷物市场（非）一体化：苏丹案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates spatial market integration in cereal markets in Sudan, focusing on wheat and sorghum, two major cereal crops. Sudan’s context provides important insights on the functioning of markets in economies marred by sanctions, conflicts, soaring inflation, and macroeconomic imbalances. We use long-ranging monthly cereal price data and a vector of error-correction cointegration model (VECM) to characterize both short-term and long-term spatial price adjustment across cereal markets. Among the 15 wheat and 18 sorghum markets considered, we can only detect significant spatial market integration among 6 wheat and 11 sorghum markets. Despite some strong spatial market integration among a few neighboring markets, there is no spatial market integration between several markets, including between major wheat consumption and production hotspots. For example, cereal markets in Darfur are not integrated with cereal markets in the rest of the country, despite exhibiting some level of spatial integration within the Darfur region. Finally, we also observe relatively stronger spatial market integration in sorghum markets than in wheat markets. These findings have important policy implications for improving the efficiency of cereal markets in Sudan and other comparable settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了苏丹谷物市场的空间市场一体化，重点关注小麦和高粱这两种主要谷物作物。苏丹的背景为受制裁、冲突、恶性通货膨胀和宏观经济失衡困扰的经济体中的市场运作提供了重要见解。我们使用长期月度谷物价格数据和误差修正协整模型（VECM）来刻画谷物市场间短期和长期的空间价格调整。在考虑的15个小麦市场和18个高粱市场中，我们仅能检测到6个小麦市场和11个高粱市场之间存在显著的空间市场一体化。尽管少数邻近市场之间存在较强的空间市场一体化，但多个市场之间，包括主要小麦消费和生产热点地区之间，不存在空间市场一体化。例如，达尔富尔的谷物市场与该国其他地区的谷物市场并未一体化，尽管在达尔富尔地区内部表现出一定程度的空间一体化。最后，我们还观察到高粱市场的空间市场一体化程度相对强于小麦市场。这些发现对于提高苏丹及其他类似环境中谷物市场效率具有重要的政策意义。

articles.title_en: The importance of farm management training for the African rice Green Revolution: Experimental evidence from rainfed lowland areas in Mozambique
articles.title_cn: 农场管理培训对非洲水稻绿色革命的重要性：来自莫桑比克雨养低地地区的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: The effectiveness of basic farm management training (e.g., seed selection, nursery bed setup, field leveling, bund construction, and transplanting) for the African rice Green Revolution has not been fully examined. This study evaluated a randomized controlled trial (RCT) of such training in the remote rainfed lowland areas of Mozambique. The training taught these practices without introducing modern varieties or inorganic fertilizers. The intention-to-treat (ITT) effect on paddy yield was 447–546 kg/ha (29 %–36 % of the control group average yield), with statistical significance at 7 %–8%. The results indicate that the adoption of these basic practices alone can improve paddy yield without relying on modern purchased inputs, which are usually not readily available in remote local markets or affordable to cash-constrained farmers. Complementarity among these basic practices is also suggested in that the yield increase had the highest statistical significance when all five practices were adopted.
articles.abstract_cn: 基础农场管理培训（如种子选择、苗床设置、田地平整、田埂建设和移栽）对非洲水稻绿色革命的有效性尚未得到充分检验。本研究在莫桑比克偏远的雨养低地地区对此类培训进行了一项随机对照试验（RCT）评估。培训仅教授这些实践，未引入现代品种或无机肥料。意向性治疗（ITT）对稻谷产量的影响为447-546公斤/公顷（对照组平均产量的29%–36%），统计显著性水平为7%–8%。结果表明，仅采用这些基础实践即可提高稻谷产量，无需依赖现代购买性投入品，这些投入品通常在偏远当地市场不易获得，或对资金受限的农民而言难以负担。这些基础实践之间的互补性也得到提示，即当所有五种实践均被采用时，产量增加的统计显著性最高。

articles.title_en: Are the laws restricting the sale of food and beverages in school cafeterias associated with obesity in adolescents in Brazilian state capitals?
articles.title_cn: 限制学校食堂销售食品和饮料的法律是否与巴西州首府青少年肥胖相关？
authors: Tatiana Resende Prado Rangel de Oliveira
articles.abstract_en: Public policies that regulate the promotion or sale of unhealthy food and beverages in schools are relevant to prevent obesity in children and adolescents. However, the relationship between food and beverage laws within schools and obesity in Brazilian adolescents needs further study. Thus, this study aims to evaluate the association between laws that restrict the sale of food and beverages in school cafeterias and obesity in adolescents from public and private schools in Brazilian capitals. Data were provided by the ERICA study, which followed a cross-sectional school-based approach. The sample consisted of adolescents aged between 12 and 17 years (n = 19,024) from Brazilian capitals (n = 27) enrolled in schools that sell food and beverages in their dependence (n = 486). The dependent variable was the presence of obesity, and the main effect was the coverage of laws restricting the sale of food and beverages in school cafeterias. Data analysis was carried out using multilevel logistic regression models. Adolescents covered by laws restricting the sale of food and beverages in school cafeterias had an 11 % lower chance of obesity (adjusted OR = 0.89; 95 % CI 0.88 – 0.91). In conclusion, laws restricting the sale of food and beverages inside schools were associated with a decrease in the chance of obesity in adolescents in Brazilian state capitals.
articles.abstract_cn: 规范学校内不健康食品和饮料推广或销售的公共政策对于预防儿童和青少年肥胖具有重要意义。然而，巴西青少年中校内食品和饮料法律与肥胖之间的关系需要进一步研究。因此，本研究旨在评估限制学校食堂销售食品和饮料的法律与巴西首府公立和私立学校青少年肥胖之间的关联。数据来自ERICA研究，该研究采用横断面学校为基础的方法。样本包括来自巴西首府（n = 27）的年龄在12至17岁之间的青少年（n = 19,024），这些青少年就读于在其附属场所销售食品和饮料的学校（n = 486）。因变量为是否存在肥胖，主要效应为限制学校食堂销售食品和饮料的法律覆盖范围。数据分析采用多水平逻辑回归模型。受限制学校食堂销售食品和饮料法律覆盖的青少年肥胖几率降低11%（调整后OR = 0.89；95% CI 0.88-0.91）。总之，限制校内食品和饮料销售的法律与巴西州首府青少年肥胖几率下降相关。

articles.title_en: Food industry influence in collaborative governance: The case of the Dutch prevention agreement on overweight
articles.title_cn: 食品行业在协作治理中的影响力：荷兰预防超重协议的案例
articles.abstract_en: Food policies to foster a healthy lifestyle are to an increasing extent developed through processes of collaborative governance in which public and private stakeholders negotiate voluntary agreements (VAs). The effectiveness of these VAs has been questioned repeatedly, because of the involvement of the food industry in drawing up these agreements.
articles.abstract_cn: 旨在促进健康生活方式的食品政策越来越多地通过协作治理过程制定，在此过程中，公共和私营利益相关者就自愿协议进行谈判。由于食品行业参与了这些协议的制定，这些自愿协议的有效性屡遭质疑。

articles.title_en: Understanding SNAP: An overview of recent research
articles.abstract_en: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) provides benefits to purchase groceries to low-income Americans. It has substantial reach, providing benefits to about 1 out of every 8 Americans. This article outlines many of the important economic questions related to SNAP and highlights the difficulty in separating correlation and causation in estimating impacts of the program. It introduces a virtual special collection of selected scholarship on SNAP published in Elsevier journals such as Food Policy, the Journal of Public Economics, and others. The studies have substantially improved our understanding of the impacts of SNAP across a range of topics, from participation decisions and work incentives to impacts on dietary quality, food security and health.
articles.abstract_cn: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）为低收入美国人提供购买食品杂货的福利。该计划覆盖面广，大约每8个美国人中就有1人受益。本文概述了与SNAP相关的许多重要经济问题，并强调了在评估该计划影响时区分相关性和因果关系的难度。文章介绍了在爱思唯尔期刊（如《食品政策》、《公共经济学杂志》等）上发表的关于SNAP的精选学术论文虚拟特辑。这些研究显著提高了我们对SNAP在从参与决策和工作激励到对饮食质量、食品安全和健康的影响等一系列主题上的理解。
